summary: Red-phase tests-only run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI client). Two compiled suites under iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests fail red on the missing vendored spec (iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching-openapi.json) and missing Package.swift wiring (swift-openapi-generator/-runtime, GeneratedAPIClient + GeneratedClientTests targets); the stubbed-response suite under iOS/Tests/GeneratedClientTests/ activates once wiring exists. Contract deltas and endpoint gaps between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json per viamin/color_matching#110) are recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client-plan.md for the PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed locally; CI (macos) runs swift test on the PR.

references.result: red — vendored document iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching-openapi.json does not exist yet (expected missing behavior)
red — iOS/Package.swift declares neither swift-openapi-generator nor swift-openapi-runtime yet
red — GeneratedAPIClient target with OpenAPIGenerator plugin + OpenAPIRuntime not declared yet
red — spec surfaces pinned (recent/manifest/ranked_results/captures/measurements/judgments) until document vendored
red — ColorMatchingLPSAppCore does not depend on GeneratedAPIClient yet; MeasurementCore client-side models (RGB/Rect/Patch/...) remain untouched by this run
suite authored (6 happy-path operations + documented 404 case, ClientTransport-level stubs, no live server) but not compiled/executed until the GeneratedClientTests test target is declared
red gate — fails until the test target wiring makes the stubbed suite runnable, so it cannot be silently skipped

delta table (9 deltas: 200-with-body upload responses, required normalized_linear_rgb_median, dropped stats/scoring_algorithm_version, polymorphic RgbPayload, integer iso, opaque white_balance_gains, flat capture compat shape, missing rejection/judgment enums, bearer auth match) and 2 endpoint gaps (manifest fields, ranked-results fields) prepared as PR-body source
